**Comment**
No opinion.

Hello @wa8eb,

Thanks for your submission. Do you have examples of a significant number of projects (e.g. those outside your own personal projects) that are using this version of this license? I'm asking because from a quick search on GitHub, I'm not seeing any references to this license outside the discussions for submission here.

As a heads-up, licenses submitted for inclusion on the SPDX License List are evaluated based on the Inclusion Principles at https://github.com/spdx/license-list-XML/blob/main/DOCS/license-inclusion-principles.md. I saw your comments on these at the top of your issue. In particular, the restrictions on use in Section 6 (Ethical Use Only) are going to make it incompatible with the open source definitions referenced in the inclusion principles.

Because of that, as with other "ethical use" licenses, unless there are a very significant number of independent projects out there that are using this particular license, it's highly unlikely that it will meet the balance of "Other factors" in the inclusion principles. So I'm going to go ahead and mark this as "Not Accepted." Thank you!
